basic_info.description: Welcome to this cute and cozy single-story home, perfectly situated just a few blocks from Ocean Beach where you can take morning walks, catch the sunsets, or simply enjoy the fresh ocean air. The location couldn't be more convenient, with Taraval Street's shops, restaurants, and MUNI lines only a couple of blocks away. The San Francisco Zoo is close by for weekend fun, and also Noriega Street offers plenty of grocery stores, local cafes, and everyday essentials. This home features spacious living room with fireplace flows into the open dining area. The eat-in kitchen is bright with western exposure, filling the space with natural light throughout the day. Two comfortable bedrooms sit side by side at the back of the home along with a full bathroom. There's also a bonus room or office above the garage, giving you extra space for work, hobbies, or guests. Freshly painted inside and out, this home also features newly refinished hardwood floors plus brand-new hardwood flooring in the kitchen and office. Large backyard offering plenty of space for gardening, outdoor dining, or just enjoying a quiet afternoon. With minimal stairs and a great location near the beach, this is a wonderful opportunity for anyone looking for a simple, comfortable home in a vibrant and friendly neighborhood.
